auth.banner.setup_needed: No admin set up yet: the web UI is open to everyone on the network.
auth.settings.api_token_missing: No API_TOKEN is set in config.py. The print API (/print/*) can therefore be used without a token, and the JSON settings API under /settings/ is locked (403). Set an API_TOKEN for automations and watchers.
auth.error.api_token_required: The settings API is locked as long as no API_TOKEN is set in config.py.
auth.error.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
auth.error.invalid_credentials: User name or password is wrong.
auth.error.setup_code_invalid: The setup code is wrong or has expired.
auth.error.name_invalid: Invalid user name: 3 to 32 characters from a–z, 0–9, ".", "_" and "-".
auth.error.name_taken: This user name is already taken.
auth.error.password_too_short: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
auth.error.password_too_long: The password may be at most {max} characters long.
auth.setup.intro: Create the admin account. After that, the web UI can only be used after logging in. The print API with X-Api-Token and the watchers keep working as before.
auth.setup.code_hint_printed: A one-time code printed by the receipt printer. It is valid for {minutes} minutes, and only the most recently printed code counts.
auth.setup.code_printed: The code has been printed and is valid for {minutes} minutes.
auth.setup.print_failed: The code could not be printed and is not valid. Please request a new one later, or create the admin account on the device with "scripts/manage_users.py create-admin".
auth.field.name: User name
auth.field.name_hint: 3 to 32 characters from a–z, 0–9, ".", "_" and "-". Upper case becomes lower case.
auth.login.remember_hint: Without the tick, the login ends when the browser is closed or after 24 hours without use. With it, the login lasts 90 days and is extended whenever it is used.
auth.account.password_hint: {min} to {max} characters. All other logins of this account are ended.
auth.account.password_changed: The password has been changed. All other logins have been ended.
auth.account.sessions_hint: Ends the login on all other devices and browsers. This device stays logged in.
